subject: Invitation: Joint webinar with Aurora Health on generative AI in clinical workflows
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Emily Chen <emily.chen@aurorahealth.org>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invitation: Joint webinar with Aurora Health on generative AI in clinical workflows

Hi Emily —

Hope you’re well. I work with the Customer Marketing team at Redwood Inference — we help healthcare teams run LLM-based features reliably in production. We’d love to invite Aurora Health to co-present a short case-study + panel with us for our clinician & health-IT audience.

High-level idea:
- 30–45 minute session: 10–15 minute Aurora case study, 15–20 minute discussion (moderated panel / fireside).
- Audience: health IT managers, informaticists, and digital transformation leads (roughly 150–250 live registrants).

Why Aurora + Redwood together:
- Showcase real-world impact (latency, cost, and reliability lessons)
- Practical takeaways for teams integrating LLMs in clinical workflows

Proposed dates: Tue, Jun 29 or Wed, Jul 7 — we can adjust for your availability. I attached a short proposed agenda and audience brief. Could you confirm:
1) Whether Aurora would be open to a 10–15 minute case study + join the panel discussion?
2) Any compliance / recording restrictions we should know about?

If you’re open, we’d also request a speaker bio (100–150 words) and a headshot. Attaching a Speaker_Bio_Request.docx to make that easy.

Thanks — excited at the prospect of featuring Aurora’s work.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Proposed_Agenda_2026-06-15.docx (docx), Aurora_Audience_Brief.pdf (pdf), Speaker_Bio_Request.docx (docx)

From: Dr. Emily Chen <emily.chen@aurorahealth.org>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <agomez@aurorahealth.org>, events@aurorahealth.org
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invitation: Joint webinar with Aurora Health on generative AI in clinical workflows

Hi Mateo —

Thanks for the invite. This sounds timely and relevant for our teams. A couple of quick notes:
- We’re comfortable presenting a 10–15 minute case study and participating in a panel discussion.
- Recording is OK, but we need review time for any marketing materials that quote clinical outcomes (standard process at Aurora).
- Jun 29 works better for our schedule; Jul 7 is tight on our end.

Looping in Alicia (our events coordinator) to handle logistics and paperwork. Alicia — can you confirm availability and next steps on the speaker agreement?

—Emily
Dr. Emily Chen
Director of Clinical AI Programs, Aurora Health
emily.chen@aurorahealth.org

Vanessa and Grace — I’ve looped you both to coordinate marketing/run-of-show and customer success prep. Quick asks from our side:

Subject: Re: Invitation: Joint webinar with Aurora Health on generative AI in clinical workflows

Hi all —

Great to have Aurora onboard. Quick details from marketing:
- Audience: primarily health IT directors & digital transformation leads; typical attendance for similar sessions ~180 live, ~600 on-demand.
- Format we recommend: 10–12 minute Aurora case study (slides), followed by a 20–25 minute fireside with one moderator + one panelist from Aurora + 1 Redwood engineer.
- Recording and on-demand: we will record and host the session; any clinical outcome quotes will be sent to Aurora for approval before publication (standard process).

Logistics / asks:
1) Can Aurora provide the speaker bio and headshot by end of day Thu, Jun 24?
2) Can we get a 1–2 slide summary of the implementation (timeline & impact) that we can include in the deck?
3) Preferred slot on Jun 29: 10:00–10:45 PT or 2:00–2:45 PT — which works better for your team?

Drive folder for assets and slides: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/aurora-webinar-2026 (permission granted to emily and alicia).

Attachments: Aurora_Audience_Brief.pdf (pdf) — includes audience breakdown and sample promo copy.

Thanks — Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Customer Marketing | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Hi Mateo & Vanessa —

Thanks — confirming Jun 29 at 10:00 PT works for us. Alicia has signed the speaker agreement (attached).

Speaker bio (100 words): Dr. Emily Chen is Director of Clinical AI Programs at Aurora Health where she leads cross-functional efforts to deploy generative AI for triage and documentation. Her team focuses on safety, clinical validation, and integrations with EHR workflows. She has published on applied NLP in clinical settings and speaks regularly on operationalizing AI in hospitals.

Headshot: emily_chen_headshot.jpg (attached)
Permissions: Aurora approves recording and use of non-identifiable quotes about operational impact, provided Aurora reviews final copy before publication.

Attached: Signed_Speaker_Agreement.pdf; emily_chen_headshot.jpg

Looking forward — Emily
Dr. Emily Chen
Director of Clinical AI Programs, Aurora Health
emily.chen@aurorahealth.org
